Current approved flavor: Everyone matched. Somehow nobody connected.
Original material and source references: []
Encounter themes: tech, first_impressions
Voice: dry, observant, a little wounded; someone telling a friend how the date went. Let a specific object or awkward behavior carry the joke. Preserve an existing line when it already works.

visual.prompt:
Write an illustration brief for a Digital Nomadia trading card.
Card: The Algorithm’s Favorite (monster_the_algorithm_s_favorite)
Campaign: Swipe Right, Regret Later
Subject: A dazzling adult guest surrounded by orbiting pastel hearts
Visible action: Rotating on a tiny display pedestal as nearby adults reach toward them but never meet their gaze
Setting: A dreamlike rooftop mixer shaped by translucent, blank app-like panels
Visual joke: Perfect visibility has produced no actual connection
Motifs: orbiting hearts, display pedestal, translucent blank panels
Composition: Centered iconic silhouette with circular movement; supporting hands stop short of the orbit; panels contain no interface or text
Palette: mint, lavender, peach, cyan, cream

Use the detail, staging, and dramatic light of a rich fantasy trading-card illustration. Translate the joke into contemporary social behavior. Use colorful Web 2.0 pastels: mint, lavender, peach, cyan, and warm cream. Keep one clear focal subject and a silhouette readable on a phone. People are fictional adults. Keep the proposed rendering style open for art direction.

The clean prompt must describe one visible scene. Do not paste the card name as lettering, source metadata, gameplay rules, or this writing assignment into it. Keep card frames, names, statistics, flavor text, and interface elements outside the image. Keep source jokes in the flavor workflow unless they describe something visible.
